fancyhealth.title: Fancy Health Indicators
fancyhealth.subtitle: health bars & damage
fancyhealth.hint.general: Hover an option to see what it does. RMB on a slider — type a value, ↺ — back to default.
fancyhealth.preview.title: LIVE PREVIEW
fancyhealth.preview.hint: LMB hit · RMB crit · MMB heal
fancyhealth.hint.reset: Click — reset the «%s» tab to the preset (highlighted in green). Shift+click — reset everything.
fancyhealth.hint.reset_all: Shift+click — reset ALL settings of every tab to the default Classic preset.
fancyhealth.search.title: Search
fancyhealth.search.try: Try: colour, font, red, #ff0000, changed, neon, walls
fancyhealth.toast.parent_changed: Also switched «%s» so this takes effect
fancyhealth.hint.needs: Works only with «%s» — changing it switches that on.
fancyhealth.preset.classic.desc: Clean bar with name and numbers, popping damage numbers.
fancyhealth.preset.mmo.desc: Craft to Exile style plate: dark frame, values inside, target frame on top.
fancyhealth.preset.hearts.desc: Rows of hearts above the head, only when hurt. Numbers fly out in arcs.
fancyhealth.preset.holo.desc: Neon cyan line, digital font with glow, fountain of numbers.
fancyhealth.preset.arcade.desc: Fighting-game slanted bars, huge bouncing numbers and crits.
fancyhealth.preset.minimal.desc: Thin line under the name, shows up only after a hit.
fancyhealth.preset.pvp.desc: Exact HP and armor on players, crosshair bar, stacked damage log.
fancyhealth.preset.boss.desc: No overhead bars: a wide boss bar for your target at the top.
fancyhealth.preset.comic.desc: Rounded chunky bars, bubbly font, spinning numbers.
fancyhealth.option.anchor.desc: Where the plate sits relative to the mob and its nametag.
fancyhealth.option.size_mode.desc: In world: shrinks with distance like a real object. Fixed: same size on screen.
fancyhealth.option.show_when.desc: Always, only when hurt, only after recent changes, or only when you look at it.
fancyhealth.option.linger.desc: How long it stays visible after a change or after you look away.
fancyhealth.option.range.desc: How far the crosshair looks for a target.
fancyhealth.option.target_style.desc: Frame with portrait, wide boss bar or a compact line.
fancyhealth.option.portrait.desc: Renders the mob's model inside the frame.
fancyhealth.option.source.desc: Who to show: what you look at, what you hit, or both.
fancyhealth.option.style.desc: Flat, glossy, rounded, segmented, slanted, neon, MMO plate, thin line, hearts or text.
fancyhealth.option.segments.desc: Number of divisions for the segmented style.
fancyhealth.option.show_name.desc: Name above the bar for mobs without a visible nametag. Hidden automatically when the vanilla nametag (players, named mobs) is already shown.
fancyhealth.option.name_scale.desc: Size of the name drawn above the bar (and in the target frame).
fancyhealth.option.name_font.desc: Font of the name above the bar and in the target frame.
fancyhealth.option.name_effect.desc: Shadow, outline or glow around the name.
fancyhealth.option.text_effect.desc: Shadow, outline, thick outline or glow.
fancyhealth.option.show_absorption.desc: Golden hearts from golden apples and Absorption.
fancyhealth.option.color_mode.desc: By health (green to red), by type (hostile red, passive green, players blue), by team or fixed.
fancyhealth.option.trail.desc: After a hit the lost chunk stays visible in its own color, waits and then drains away.
fancyhealth.option.trail_hold.desc: How long the lost chunk stays before it starts shrinking.
fancyhealth.option.hit_flash.desc: At the moment of a hit only the lost chunk lights up, then fades into the drain color.
fancyhealth.option.animation.desc: Pop, rise, fountain, bounce, zoom, shake, slide, spiral or stacked log.
fancyhealth.option.merge.desc: Hits on the same mob within this window add up into one growing number.
fancyhealth.option.format.desc: Smart, whole numbers, one decimal, hearts or percent of max HP.
fancyhealth.option.distance_scaling.desc: 0 — same size at any distance, 1 — fully perspective.
fancyhealth.option.color_by_type.desc: Fire orange, magic purple, fall gray, explosions yellow and so on.
fancyhealth.option.only_mine.desc: Hide numbers from fights you are not part of.
fancyhealth.option.show_self.desc: Show numbers when you take damage (third person).
fancyhealth.option.npc_numbers.desc: Show damage numbers when you hit NPCs and mannequins (training dummies), even if their HP bar is hidden.
fancyhealth.option.npcs.desc: Server NPCs (player-shaped entities that are not in the Tab list) and mannequins. Off — HP only for real players and living mobs.
fancyhealth.option.mod_enabled.desc: Also bound to a key in Controls.
fancyhealth.option.occlusion.desc: Like nametags: behind blocks only when the nick itself shows through walls (player not sneaking, or a see-through server nametag), dimmed. Always hide: never through blocks. Invisible entities are never shown.
fancyhealth.option.server_nametags.desc: Detects custom nametags made of text displays (like /nametags on Astrum duels) and places bars above or below them without repeating the name.
fancyhealth.option.tab_health.desc: If the server shows health under the nick (TAB belowname) but hides real HP of players, take HP from there. The bar also moves above that line.
